title: Damaged Carbon Steel Firefighting Pipes Delivered with Surface Corrosion & Bevel Deformity
description: During MIR-0035 inspection, 60 meters of ASTM A53 150mm dia pipes exhibited heavy surface oxidation and crushed pipe ends exceeding ASME B36.10 tolerances.
rootCause: Improper strapping on flatbed transport trailer and failure of weather-protective tarp during coastal transit.
correctiveAction: Defective pipes separated and moved to quarantined red zone. Supplier issued debit note and replacement dispatch scheduled for 15-Oct-2026.
preventiveAction: Supplier QA logistics protocol updated to require heavy-duty end protectors and closed-curtain trucks for future consignments.
